subtitle: "Synthetic validation case study"

## Operational question

Is the observed ring-like persistence stronger than expected from a surrogate preserving selected non-topological properties?

## Statistic and null

Pre-register maximum $H_1$ persistence, a Betti curve distance and radial variation. A teaching surrogate independently permutes one coordinate, preserving the separate coordinate marginals while destroying their pairing.

## Complete-pipeline comparison

Reconstruct the point cloud, Rips filtration and diagram for every surrogate. Compare the observed statistic with the empirical distribution, then repeat under a second justified surrogate when moving to scientific data.

## Baseline

Radial coefficient of variation may already detect the deliberately constructed ring. Topology adds value only if it supplies information or robustness beyond that baseline.

## Interpretation boundary

Coordinate shuffling is transparent but rarely a sufficient physical null for a swarm. An exceedance proportion is not a calibrated scientific p-value without an exchangeability or data-generating argument.
